steps.content:
All 10 tests pass now, and `npm run report` prints the expected March and April totals. I committed the change on `master` but couldn't push, because the repo has no remote.

What was wrong, all in `src/`:
- **`csv.js`:** it split on every comma and `\n`. It now parses properly, so quoted commas, doubled quotes (`""`) and `\r\n` line endings all work.
- **`money.js`, rounding:** `toCents` used `Math.floor`, so `0.29` became 28 cents. It now uses `Math.round`.
- **`money.js`, padding:** `formatCents` didn't pad the cents, so 1205 printed as `12.5` instead of `12.05`. It now pads to two digits.
- **`report.js`:** `totalsByMonth` was an unfinished stub that returned `{}`. It now sums cents per `YYYY-MM`.

I didn't touch the tests.

outcome.description: npm test passes (10 of 10) after the run
